crossRefs.note: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

translations.web: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?
translations.bsb: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?
translations.kjv: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
translations.asv: Doth the fountain send forth from the same opening sweet water and bitter?
